about: Changes to the web-exported wings that unreal/Pipeline/blender/prepare_for_unreal.py makes while it prepares them for Unreal: 'drop' removes meshes (Blender object names as the glTF import gives them, regular expressions matched whole), 'move' carries a group of meshes as one piece: it turns them by rotate_deg about the campus vertical through pivot (campus x, z; +90 turns something facing campus -z, north, to face campus -x, west) and puts the pivot at 'to' (campus x, z), dy metres higher; 'clip' deletes every face whose corners all lie inside 'box' (campus x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1), from every mesh or from the 'meshes' named, and only the faces of the 'material' named when there is one. Campus axes: x east, y up, z south; the import maps campus (x, y, z) to Blender (x, -z, y). 'flush' lays the flat covers named in 'meshes' onto the face each belongs on (the face of another mesh facing the same way just under it, the frontmost within 8 cm), 2 mm in front of it, its corners snapped to that face's corners. 'nudge' moves the faces of 'material' lying wholly inside 'box' up by 'dy' metres (trims laid in one plane, stacked a few millimetres apart so they never flicker). 'rail_desks' turns the Wax Hall reading rails' brass desks (material 'material') to lie behind their cards ('cards': the cards' mesh names) and brings the legs under them.

Yard.note: The Training Wing's east wall (bl/training.py, bl/exterior.py SHELLS 'training') stands on the yard fence's west run (x 32.2, z -33.9..-13.2), which stays buried inside the wall except where the wing's double doorway (z -26.7..-24.9) opens through it: the rails and posts along the wall are cut out, the fence north of the wing's corner (z < -27.1) stays.

clip.what: the yard fence inside the Training Wing's east wall

nudge.what: the playground's mulch, over the end of the tiled path (they lay in one plane and flickered)
the merry-go-round's navy spokes, over the red ones where they cross

School.note: Room 104 becomes the XR Classroom (bl/classroom.py adds the smartboard, the desks and chairs, the teacher's desk and the new door sign): the computers desk, its stools and computers, the outdated 'Built in a browser' panel and the old door sign and the faces of the hall's blade sign go (bl/classroom.py puts new ones in their place); the layer table moves to the back of the room, the beanbags to the back-left corner and the World Builder book onto the teacher's desk. The mural (the layer table's station sign), the free-tools shelf, the token and the window stay.

move.what: the layer table, turned so its label faces the class
the beanbags, to the back-left corner
the World Builder book with its stand and label, onto the teacher's desk facing the class

nudge.what: the desk pad on the school office counter, 1 mm over the top (it flickered)

LibraryShell.note: The books on display (the stacks' ends and the table by the reference desk) are each a block and a cover picture. The web export tilted the covers back about 14 degrees but left the blocks upright, so in Unreal each block's front face cut across its cover and hid nearly half of it: the covers are laid flat on their blocks' front faces instead.

flush.what: the displayed books' covers, onto their blocks

WaxHall.note: Each stage's front edge has a brass nosing and a black strip laid in the stage's own plane, and three computer screens lay in their monitors' faces: all flickered, so the trims are stacked 2 and 4 mm up and the screens laid 2 mm out. Each stage's reading rail is a card on a brass desk on two legs. The web turned the desk by the card's own tilt, but the desk starts flat and the card upright, so the desk stood square to the card, leaning back toward the stage, and cut across it (the podium faced the other way): each desk is rebuilt parallel to its card, just behind it, its legs under it.

clip.what: the brass rope post under the 2024 scene's card (its ball came up through the card)
the brass rope post under the 2025 scene's card

nudge.what: the stages' black edge strip, west
the stages' black edge strip, east
the end stages' black edge strip

flush.what: the computer screens (2016, 2022b, 2024), onto their monitors
